scope: MHC class I peptide ligands are typically isolated by MHC immunoaffinity chromatography (MHC-IAC)

MAE is independent of antibodies and elutes peptides from MHC-I... directly from intact cells without lysing them.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The analyzed material consists of MHC-peptide complexes purified via either immunoaffinity chromatography (MHC-IAC) or mild acid elution (MAE) to isolate the immunopeptidome. While MAE targets the cell surface, the overall scope is the purification of the MHC complex/ligands rather than a whole cell lysate.
